name: Changes & features grid
author: Brett
description: One grid of every change (the Codebase changes log, read through axf.changes@1) and every feature (the plan). Each row is titled with its thread / request name and its date and time, and expands to show the details: what was asked, steps, result, branch, commits and links for a change; status, summary, ports, files, acceptance and history for a feature. Filter changes / features / both, search, sort.
